name: tracetrim
description: tracetrim learns from traces which tool output fields an agent visibly reuses and trims the rest. The expand tool returns a retained original result. The tracetrim_done tool closes a run with the agent's final answer. When tracetrim fronts other MCP servers, Guard sees one server. Proxied tools keep Guard's normal handling.
saferAlternatives: Include only the upstream servers needed for the task in the proxy configuration.
Use a private work directory for traces, which can contain tool results and final answers.
